params.name: q
params.description:
Returns the images for the search term (q).

Example: q=uetliberg

params.name: lat
params.description:
Returns the photos from the “Image Archive Online” catalog whose camera location is near a defined point. Or the point is defined for a provenance in the catalog “Ex meis libris”. The point is defined by lat (latitude) and long (longitude) and optionally dist (radius) in meters (default: 1000).

Example: lat=47.349952

params.name: lon
params.description: Returns the photos from the “Image Archive Online” catalog whose camera location is near a defined point. Or the point is defined for a provenance in the catalog “Ex meis libris”. The point is defined by lat (latitude) and long (longitude) and optionally dist (radius) in meters (default: 1000).

params.name: dist
params.description:
Returns the photos from the “Image Archive Online” catalog whose camera location is near a defined point. Or the point is defined for a provenance in the catalog “Ex meis libris”. The point is defined by lat (latitude) and long (longitude) and optionally dist (radius) in meters (default: 1000).

Example: dist=1000

params.name: edges
params.description:
Should the edges/relations to contributors also be returned (default: true)?

Example: edges=false
